page.overview:
Who is Annika Van Houten?

Annika Van Houten is a member of the Van Houten Family. She is a character who debuted in the Season 26 episode, "Let's Go Fly a Coot".

She was voiced by guest star Carice van Houten.

She is one of Milhouse's cousins from the Netherlands. In her debut episode, she smokes e-cigarettes and sparked a "romantic" interest in Bart. Because of this Bart began to smoke as well until Marge and Luann discovered this and they forbade the two from seeing each other again. Even though Bart showed interest in her, (even going to the airport to see her off) he actually admitted to her that he didn't like her, mainly because the only time she was actually nice to Bart was when she wanted something. She is a background character too.

Annika has long blue hair and blue eyebrows. She wears a pink shirt, a purple jumper over her shirt, gray leggings, and fuchsia and white colored sneakers. She also wears several earrings and a necklace with a pink pearl. Her hair and eyebrows look very similar to Milhouse's.
